scripts.build: rm -rf build && cp -R custom_components/ha_notifications/. build/ && esbuild frontend/panel.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=build/frontend/panel.js
scripts.format:backend: ruff format custom_components/ha_notifications tests/backend scripts && ruff check --fix custom_components/ha_notifications tests/backend scripts
scripts.check:backend: ruff format --check custom_components/ha_notifications tests/backend scripts && ruff check custom_components/ha_notifications tests/backend scripts
scripts.test: npm run check:frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run build && vitest run
